changes: Federated selection now derives consensus only from executable candidates that contain both repository changes and validation commands.
Exact same change content proposed by multiple candidates adds a bounded ranking signal; a non-executable proposal cannot manufacture that support.
Different executable variants targeting the same path add a bounded conflict penalty and are surfaced in the consensus receipt.
Single-candidate behavior stays deterministic and consensus-neutral; the selector still chooses one proposal rather than composing unvalidated cross-candidate changes.
